faqs.q: How often should I repeat it?
faqs.a: Every 4-6 weeks for combination/oily skin, every 8 weeks for dry or normal skin.
We recommend waiting 4-6 hours. Your skin will look better without makeup for the rest of the day.

faqs.q: Is it the same as a HydraFacial?
faqs.a: No. HydraFacial is a device brand. Our deep facial cleansing is a manual medical protocol with personalized extraction.

faqs.q: Can I come before an event?
faqs.a: Yes, ideally 48-72 hours before so the skin has time to stabilize.
